name: Dvoe
source:
Two professional, well‑trained but young operatives deliberately get into «Sovyonok». Their goal is to find and copy data about the camp. However, things don’t go in favour of the young investigators. This camp doesn’t give up its secrets to anyone without a price…

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=770709137]Steam[/url]]
translation:
两名训练有素但年轻的专业特工故意进入“索维诺克”。他们的目标是查找并复制有关营地的数据。然而，事情并没有对年轻的调查人员有利。这个营地不会无偿地向任何人泄露它的秘密……

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=770709137]Steam[/url]]
